name: ⛏️ Mines
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Mines! ⛏️

Mine and explore unique caves in search of ores, rare treasures, and crazy items. Sell your finds to upgrade your pickaxe, unlock powerful radars, and operate DRILLS!

💎 Hire OFFLINE MINERS to mine for you while you're OFFLINE!

Can you discover what all is hidden in the Mines?

Play with friends and mine the caves together for a boost!
